newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Feb 3.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Bunker prices held steady, with levels seen easing nearer the end of the day on lower cargo quotes, brokers said on Monday. A major said bids and offers were far apart as some sellers hiked levels, earlier in the day, taking advantage of firmer demand seen ahead of the Lunar New Year holidays. Two majors were sold out of bunker supplies until the February 11, traders said. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
